verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a handoff or escalation capability for the Support Agent. Nothing shows configurable handoff conditions by topic, sentiment, customer tier, or explicit customer request, nor any reliability guarantee. Natural-language runbooks, issue assignment to the agent, and generic triggers are related controls but do not establish the agent handing off to humans under configured rules.
